<!-- This exercise is authored by Karsten Lübke. -->





```{r libs, include = FALSE}
library(mosaic)
library(tidyr)
library(exams)
```


```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
questions <- c("A", "B", "C", "D")
# Random Data
mw <- sample(2*1:5,1)

mwa <- mw
sda <- mw * 1/2

mwb <- sda
sdb <- mw

mwc <- mw
sdc <- mw * 3/2

mwd <- sdc
sdd <- mwc

minx <- min(c(mwa-3*sda, mwb-3*sdb, mwc-3*sdc,mwd-3*mwd))
maxx <- max(c(mwa+3*sda, mwb+3*sdb, mwc+3*sdc,mwd+3*mwd))
x <- seq(minx,maxx, length = 1000)

verteilungen <- data.frame(x = x) %>%
  mutate(A = dnorm(x, mean = mwa, sd =sda)) %>%
  mutate(B = dnorm(x, mean = mwb, sd =sdb)) %>%
  mutate(C = dnorm(x, mean = mwc, sd =sdc)) %>%
  mutate(D = dnorm(x, mean = mwd, sd =sdd)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=c(A,B,C,D), values_to = "Dichte")


richtig <- sample(1:4,1)

if (richtig == 1) {mwt <- mwa;sdt <- sda}
if (richtig == 2) {mwt <- mwb;sdt <- sdb}
if (richtig == 3) {mwt <- mwc;sdt <- sdc}
if (richtig == 4) {mwt <- mwd;sdt <- sdd}

solutions <- rep(FALSE, 4)
solutions[richtig] <- TRUE
```


Question
========

```{r show-plot, echo = FALSE, results="hide", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 6, fig.cap = ""}
gf_line(Dichte ~ x | name, data = verteilungen)
```


Welche der Abbildungen zeigt eine Normalverteilung mit $$\mu=`r mwt`$$ und $$\sigma=`r sdt`?$$



```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(questions, markup = "markdown")
```



Solution
========


Aufgabenname: `verteilungen1`



```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(solutions, "Richtig", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
